notes.title: STEAM SUMMER SALES 2024
notes.content:
Gamers,

We announce the opening of this '[b]Summer Steam Sales[/b]' from RolldBox Games, and we are offering a reduced price so you don't miss out on the world we have created for you, featuring the following NEW UPDATES:

1. [u]The catalog of actions around the Planet[/u]. Once the game is completed, the player receives a certificate after executing the selected action:

🍃 Protect 100ft² Of Wildlife Habitat

🐢 Save A Sea Turtle

🌳 Plant a Tree

🏞   Buy 10ft² Of Land For Nature Reserves

🌊 Protect 1000 M² Of Marine Area

💨 Carbon Offset

🪸 Coral Restoration

♻ Clean Ocean Plastic


2. [u]Other improvements[/u]:

🧲 Pulse | Temporarily heals the area of the planet you're in, reducing its aggression while you explore and heal it permanently.

✨ Enhanced Colors | The color palette has been enriched to offer a more vibrant and immersive visual experience.

🐠 Addition of Wildlife | Birds, fish, etc., which can become more aggressive towards the player until they are healed.

💚 Evolution of Flora | Carnivorous plants.

🩹 More Abilities with Partial Healing | Expand your repertoire, bringing a new layer of strategy and depth to the survival system.


Additionally, this price includes the [b]full game[/b]: [b]mini-games linked to the different suits[/b], which increase in difficulty. It's perfect for [b]cooperative play with friends[/b]. It's very fun and an ideal video game for sharing quality time with your family!


Not only that, but it's not meant to be a relaxing game; it's an adventure filled with challenges and features different energy modes you can use. An ideal game designed for when you get off work so you can play for a while in the evening — you'll benefit from a wellness element as you restore and recover the Planet. It falls under '[b]Positive Gaming[/b]' because you can enjoy watching the entire space being restored, the fauna and flora coming back to life, and the [i]Torek[/i] interacting with you. With a wealth of characters and a deep narrative, it's an experience you won't forget. 

THIS SUMMER, play with us. [u]You have until Thursday, July 11th[/u], to take advantage of this content at this price:

[previewyoutube=iVGxNepjp8k;full][/previewyoutube]

👽🪐💦

[b][h3]JOIN OUR DISCORD[/h3][/b] https://discord.com/invite/c8ZXujGhN7

notes.title: Update of Those Who Came: Healing Solarus !!
notes.content:
Hello Gamers!

We have been able to check the Those Who Came status, and gather some of the issues that might have been affecting you all on your journey through Solarus. From the different issues found and also notified by you, we have been able to address most of them!

We have identified a critical issue that could cause the game to get stuck and force the players to restart the mission, forcing them to go through an unnecessary set of menus and maps.

There was a mission that could be blocked if the players skipped a step by opening a door before being asked, now the mission will keep going if the case is matched.

In addition to this major fix, we have been able to identify a set of more quality of life improvements and issues that were affecting the experience:

[list]
[*] Language typos mostly happening in Spanish and Catalan
[*] At the start of a mission, an empty dialogue box could appear and never fade
[*] Certain trees have been relocated and now they are not floating
[*] Modified map boundaries to properly adjust to the playable pathing
[*] Visual issue with certain consoles when using the Surface Walker suit
[*] Visual issue with the energy tubes that they weren’t displayed at the right pace, but all of them at the end of the quest
[*] Visual issue where certain objects where being occluded and were hardly visible
[*] Improved the visuals for the healing plants to make it easier to see when is healing
[*] Adjusted the Torek archives and the batteries to only appear when not obtained 
[/list]


We hope that with these fixes your experience with Those Who Came: Healing Solarus improves and helps you to reach Bineok. We need to save this world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/32b903f9034d47313196d353918c27e445a0eea9.png[/img]

Also! If you'd like to be posted on the latest news, give us some human tips or just have a chat over coffee then you can always joing our discord server! The invite is just a click away ;) 

[url=https://discord.com/invite/c8ZXujGhN7][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/7c2e73b9eb046815d27c28631cc2a6f26647ec2d.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Full Demo Version of Those Who Came: Healing Solarus is now available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/4352594371af205aa6d3a1a1955d9c16ae9a1cdf.png[/img]

Dear explorers of Planet Solarus 👽

As the almighty date of our final launch approaches, we are eager to announce major news in our endeavour. It has been a thrilling ride on our rockets, ready for the next chapter that the indie development world is ready to bring us.

March had been a month of showcasing the new prospects for Those Who Came: Healing Solarus inside the Game Developers Conference Spanish Pavillion, in San Francisco. We had the amazing opportunity to show the fruits of the massive feedback we gathered all these months, resulting in a Demo we’d love players all over the world to enjoy! 

Consequently, the jump of improvement in all aspects of the product has led us to the final decision of discontinue any Early Access update, as we feel the product we had does differ greatly from the final title you will all be able to see during summer. Instead of focusing our energy on small updates of the Early Access title, we prefer focusing on the final product. Fasten your seatbelts, great things are about to arrive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/41752e9f03c463af195c898102aebeb180f641f1.png[/img]


[b]THOSE WHO CAME DISCONTINUES EARLY ACCESS UPDATES[/b]

But what does this mean for our loyal players? 

[u]If you purchased Those Who Came or you have a Key code[/u], you will keep having access to the title once the date of our final launch ignites and publishes the game in our store.
By now, we will also ensure that you are able to play the Demo version available by selecting the named "PUBLICDEMO" in the Betas area. If you have any technical questions, don’t hesitate to ask! We would be happy to assess you through them all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/76c168d4cbb8c3d78ca707bf1920e70b1d87e019.gif[/img]

[b]NEW DEMO AVAILABLE[/b]

The Demo of Those Who Came: Healing Solarus is a special map created for this Demo, closely related to the game’s narrative and presenting key elements of both mechanics and a mysteriously important character you should beware. Your main goal is to discover why Solarus is corrupted and help the planet regain its past splendor with what you have at hand. 

Oh, explorers, don’t forget you can[u] review the Demo[/u] for the sake of our future missions! We encourage you to bring your word of explorer.

Last but not least, we would like to thank everyone involved, from other developer teams to the amazing community and loving curators, in all the feedback that has led us to polish our game to the maximum level possible. We could not have done it without you! 



[b]KEY FEATURES FOR THE FULL RELEASE:[/b]

[list]
[*] Choose your own style by using the energy with the different shapers: Airy, Ether, Firei and Jointer.
[*] Explore and find the different suits to interact with the world and restore life in Solarus to turn it into your new home. 
[*] The more you heal, the better it gets. By caring for the planet, you will be able to face the final challenge with some advantages.
[*] Play either alone or along with your friends, into a campaign with plenty of challenges to stop Bineok and his final experiment. 
[*] Dive into our Arcade mode, where you can face your friends in competitive PVP arenas. Harness the versatility of all 4 energies using them creatively on other players.
[/list]

Don’t forget you can always join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/c8ZXujGhN7] Discord Community[/url] today and stay in touch! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/7c2e73b9eb046815d27c28631cc2a6f26647ec2d.png[/img]

See you at launch, explorer! 🚀

notes.title: Those Who Came Major Update !
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow explorers! 

Today is a big day for Those Who Came. We are proud to announce our biggest update to date, a work that comes with several fixed issues and the introduction of a New Tutorial System to guide you through your first steps as a Sainen, among other juicy perks.  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/979cc244a7a3eaf39a6cebe3a6b59ba997d1c667.png[/img]


Thanks to this much needed guidance, you will be learning to choose between Energies and know how to use them with the Shapers way faster and easier than in our previous update. Do not forget that the suit you wear is your battery and the source of your abilities. Charge your suit by absorbing energy from the environment and choose among the four Energies–Firei, Ether, Airy and Jointer–the one most attuned to you. The Shapers will enable you to leverage your energy for maximum effectiveness. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/13c43d559d9af0145dbebd6d382397721decba84.png[/img]


[b]February 25th Update Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] We have added the second configuration of the Jointer: Jointer Mimic !
[*] The Energy System has been reduced to 10 levels. You will learn the second configuration of your Energy when reaching said level.
[*] Onboarding experience improved, as well as the Energy introductory levels, we highly recommend to replay the maps !
[*] These maps now contain a speedrun timer to see who is the fastest Sainen in the Galaxy!
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/6481b5f86bbc29f5e90cb7e48a9bbeaabbd6986e.png[/img]


[b]February 25th Update Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed many issues related to the Mission System
[*] Translation related text mistakes fixed
[*] Cave Expedition issues fixed
[*] Navigation issues found in the game maps fixed 
[*] Issues with the color outlines related to energies solved
[*] Errors with the Steam icons when playing online resolved
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/9a03be7197591e1e60ff61608505d1c3d1ff39ca.png[/img]


[b]Additional changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Quest Target icon has been changed for visibility purposes
[*] Improved navigation pathings on the caves for the last puzzles
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/c69d063c1d50e499c09ce8157a5c0c84b627f181.png[/img]


As Those Who Came nears its full release, some optional gameplay features will come out of the game to be refreshed and optimized for future post-launch updates while other exciting features will be introduced at launch for the first time. So stay tuned! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/d2e8c4bee931da959f72b676989941f5616d6f47.png[/img]


Said that, we can’t wait to see you play our latest version of Those Who Came! Do you have any feedback? Tell us in the comment section, or [url=https://discord.com/invite/c8ZXujGhN7]join our Discord community[/url] today.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/7c2e73b9eb046815d27c28631cc2a6f26647ec2d.png[/img]


Happy gaming!

notes.title: Hot fixes and new features
notes.content:
[h1]Hot fixes and new features of 0.7.14.8 version[/h1]

After [b]X-MASS major update[/b] of December 9th, we continue developing and improving things by listening to the community.
Thanks for all the feedback received and enjoy playing this Christmas Holidays with all these new elements!


[h2][Features][/h2]

•	User Interface adaptation: We have changed the position of the layout for the suit interface, ensuring a better comprehension of the gameplay capabilities, also adding the player HUD with extra information about their teammates.
•	Now you can see your and your team Steam icons in the UI.
•	PvP Gameplay modified: we have simplified the game experience to make it smoother and leave more room to develop the synergies between energies and teams.
•	We have adjusted the speed of the Jointer ball: Now jointers can chase down any speedy teammate to ensure that they don’t become blocked because of the ball pursuing another player.
•	Now destroyable rocks by Firei can be crossed from the moment they have been destroyed, not after they fully glow.
•	Added new health dropables in the caves helping the players to outrun the threats of Solarus.
•	New tutorial messages for the main mechanics and features added to ensure that the basics are understood properly. 


[h2][Fixes][/h2]

•	Fixed issue that prevented some achievements from being accomplishable.
•	Fixed several missions from Solarus Surface.
•	Fixed economy issues related to obtaining new mods and suits.
•	Fixed vendors to let them sell specific products from day or night.
•	Solved visual element issues with minor resolutions and quality settings.
•	Modified quest objective visuals for better performance.
•	General improvements on game performance focused specifically on the Surface of Solarus.
•	Solved visual displays on the dialogues.
•	Improved infrastructures over the surface for a better experience playing expeditions.
•	Fixed issue with the quest log that didn’t display when needed.
•	Fixed issues with quest targets that remained in the world after completing the quest.
•	Fixed issues with the energies video showcases.
•	Cinematics now mute all the game when running, preventing an issue of hearing world elements while playing them.
•	The Commander Artissa now does not block in the tutorial pathing, ensuring she reaches the end no matter what the player does.
•	Solved an issue in the HERMAION ship that prevented the player from leaving the area the first time.
•	Solved an issue that prevented some players from binding themselves to a certain energy.
•	Improved performance of the loading screen, ensuring that it disappears at the correct moment letting the player play from moment 0.
•	Fixed issue with Toreks at caves that didn’t appear properly.
•	Fixed issue that forced players to see the introduction at the personal ship every time they entered.
•	Fixed issue that didn’t update properly each player when reaching their personal ship, forcing them to reload the game to see their true progression.
•	Fixed issue in the last Solarus Surface mission that sent players back to the spaceship where they could not start any new mission.
•	Fixed an issue in the Firei binding level, where players could die and had to restart the game.
•	Modified some gameplay elements in the Caves that made players feel dizzy about what to do or how.


[h2][Other changes][/h2]

•	Fixed some issues with navigation elements.
•	Added sounds on the proper surfaces that weren’t set accordingly.
•	Fixed some sounds that weren’t binded to “Sound configurations”.
•	General improvements on the visuals of the surface, giving a better perception of the day/night.
•	Changed size of the searching display to ensure each text is readable.
•	General improvements on text translations.
•	Adjusted some visual elements related to interactable objects with proper outlines and colors.
•	Prevented the Shade of torek from disappearing when he had talked to players.
•	Fixed Sainen ship minor navigation issues that prevented some players from moving around.
•	Fixed suit textures that were shown incorrectly.
•	Fixed an issue in the Stadium “Learning the basics” that forced the player to play without their equipment.
•	Adjusted some items over the Solarus Surface that weren’t placed properly.
•	Fixed minor issues over the Energy binding levels that created confusion in the gameplay and added minor helpers.


[h2][Images of new User Interface][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/f80109b56577eaf2abb3b92b4c0131a61115fbdf.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/a1fa290e5be10acc9d86b47789f03f6fef029241.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/0cfda8f1e0cedb41e8ca73098bd10c338d858024.jpg[/img]



[h2]COMMUNITY[/h2]
[h3]Follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1708570/Those_who_Came/]Steam page[/url] and stay tuned for upcoming updates.[/h3]
[h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1708570/discussions/]Report any bugs[/url] & [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1708570/discussions/]share your ideas[/url] with us.[/h3]
[h3]Subscribe to the newsletter on our [url=https://thosewhocame.com/]official web page[/url].[/h3]
[h3]Follow us on social media:[/h3]
[url=https://web.facebook.com/rolldboxgames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/b413a981c0c4f1e8f6ea73e61f29601f4aaae3f3.png[/img][/url] [url=https://twitter.com/rolldboxgames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/6a0c9d41e6caecaf4dfa9fa2efd3e93bf8f1a78b.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.instagram.com/rolldboxgames/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/d9b92a8301fb46dc13ce8dc331ed741340037f7c.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCrMahRMkX1ps3JYnv7il9AA][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/40c05619a0ea1541573576be52765ea0d0f775ba.png[/img][/url] [url=https://discord.gg/NX5gzujRMV][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/288c39a71a3d30b3cebb6b38483ed5d96041a805.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: X-MASS update coming on December 9th
notes.content:
Morning, explorers,

As we told you on Twitter last Friday, we are very happy to announce that the next [b]major update[/b] for Those Who Came is about to be released. 

The update will hit Steam [b]on December 9th[/b] with more content, technical improvements to the game's core features and much more. We truly believe this is a significant leap forward compared to previous builds, and one that puts us closer to our vision for Those Who Came. 

With this new update, we have made some changes to our [b]roadmap[/b], you can check them below.


⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/897d5fcd308117a21597f6152a386c4aca88971b.jpg[/img]

Among the new features, we have renamed some mechanics, and introduced some slight changes in the number of players that will be needed to complete some tasks. We have also tweaked the party system to create a more seamless experience, added new maps and did a ton of bug fixing.

Let's spell the changes out part by part!


[b][h3]Adapting the terminology[/h3][/b]
Science fiction transports players to futuristic contexts — often far removed from their own in both space and time — where scientific and technological innovations define everything. In contrast to fantasy works, here unlikely events must have a logical and rational basis. For this very reason, we understand that words like "magic", or “spells”, don’t fit a story like ours. Therefore, the upcoming patch will rename the elemental abilities of the Sainen: from now on, we’ll always refer to them as “Energies”.


⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/5cb4f3acc8fbff9042e5bb3136c5779b241e05a8.jpg[/img]

In this sci-fi context, the devices used by the Sainen to catalyze these energies of the Universe will be called “Shapers”, not “magic props”; and each player will be able to set four types of configuration depending on the ability we need to use.

Also, for the sake of consistency, the way in which the chosen shaper is configured will be called “configuration” instead of the previous “spell”.


[b][h3]Tweaked energies[/h3][/b]
The Sainen, as an advanced civilization, are capable of [b]handling special energies that serve them as a way to interact with the environment[/b] in many different ways. 

There are [b]4 different types of energies[/b], all related to a specific element:

[list]
[*] [b]Airy:[/b] Levitation. Creates energy flows that make the player ascend and be able to access unreachable areas. It also prevents them from big falls. 
[*] [b]Firei:[/b] Glowing Orb. The Firei energy becomes a light in the darkness, and can melt down certain objects. 
[*] [b]Ether:[/b] Shade. Ether gives the players the ability to reshape themselves or other objects. This is useful to go through walls and strong structures to reach new areas.
[*] [b]Jointer:[/b] Object transmutation. Jointer empowers your companions and creates new paths by energizing the environment.
[/list]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/1733b23d6d48156cac39b3b4d72f61fa6bfae65e.jpg[/img]

In order to use the energies, each Sainen will first need to establish a link with the ability they want to master, and will have the option to practice in a tutorial level specifically designed for this purpose. Your kind has awakened after a long period of time, and will need to start all over again from scratch; thus, you will begin learning any ability from the basic level.

During your mission on planet Solarus, you will find some energy spikes to capture and get some “configurations”; that is, the way to set up the devices -”Shapers”- to generate the energies.


⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/36fcf0db775b2828d843dd7f49e88b73e98abe84.jpg[/img]

The energy skill levels range from 1 to 50, which is the highest. As you level up, using the energies will become increasingly difficult, even much more if you are trying to excel in all of them. Playing with friends means that each of your companions can specialize in one or two of these energies, depending on the number of players. However, it is also possible for only one player to master all of them -it’s extremely challenging, but achievable!


[b][h3]Multiplayer experience[/h3][/b]
Those Who Came is a [b]multiplayer game[/b]. We recommend that you gather [b]4 friends[/b] to be able to enjoy the whole experience, but there are several missions that can be played in Single player mode, and others that will require a minimum of 2 players. For the last missions you may need all the 4 to complete the adventure. We have tweaked this number as before there were some missions that needed up to 7 players to be completed.


⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/5f82743d02937d2774478b60f50ac7abc2a86efa.jpg[/img]

Remember that as a crew, you have access to a PvP area called The Stadium that can only be enjoyed in multiplayer mode. It is a very exciting place where you can upgrade your equipment, earn Halis, and test your skills with the energy you have gathered -not individually, but with your friends! PvP can be played in two groups of 2, the minimum required, two groups of 3, or two groups of 4. There are several options for two different parties to play together, and have fun while mastering their energies!


⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/fad235802b2095c44034bd0ac227a6aae4fa62bd.jpg[/img]


[b][h3]New maps[/h3][/b]
Along their journey, the Sainen will have to learn about Solarus, the planet that is meant to be their new home: its surface, its environment, its fauna and flora, and how to establish contact with the natives. Solarus also changes its behaviour depending on the day and night cycles! 

The next update will bring some very interesting new areas to the map. For example, the Torek’s Cave, an unknown part of the planet with some environmental peculiarities, where the native inhabitants of the planet, the Torek, are surprisingly able to live. The Sainen will need to discover Solarus and its possibilities through the different missions; it’s a vast planet with many areas to explore, so it won’t be an easy task!


⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/ca1e641d601c313e46cf744d4982b403831f2d7f.jpg[/img]

All these new places will help the Sainen to understand more about Solarus' history, and discover relevant elements that will have a key impact on how to heal the planet and make it fit to live in. 


[b][h3]Characters[/h3][/b]
The update of Dec 9th will also bring [b]new names to certain elements and characters in the story[/b]. We have been thinking on how some of them could be improved to better fit the story and the world we have created. With this in mind, we decided to rename some of them; the most remarkable changes are the name of the Sainen Commander, who we will call Artissa from now on, and the main ship, HERMAION.


⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/4d73ab66d2f2e463ee0d0fd05e592734f7c74bee.jpg[/img]

Another important decision has been to [b]discard all characters’ voices[/b]. We realised that too many new recordings would be needed, as the number of NPCs with dialogues we had originally planned to include in the story had increased considerably. Instead, we will use very brief sounds to identify the speaker, and will most likely review sounds and voices thoroughly in upcoming updates. 


[b][h3]Bug fixing and QoL improvements[/h3][/b]
We have also added some hotfixes to this new update. Regarding our party system, for instance, we have solved several bugs in order to improve performance and stability, while including several quality of life improvements. Besides, as usual with a new update, we have polished the build to remove bugs. 




Here are all the things to [b]look forward to on Dec 9th[/b]! 

For more news, updates, or a friendly chat about the game, we invite you to follow and join the conversations here on the [b]Steam forums[/b], our community on [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/aSNuvRsUHj]Discord[/url][/b], and our social media channels, [b][url=https://mobile.twitter.com/rolldboxgames]Twitter[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/rolldboxgames/]Instagram[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://www.reddit.com/user/rolldboxgames/]Reddit[/url][/b].

Take care and have a great week!

notes.content:

Com a part del nostre mapa de treball i dels suggeriments rebuts pels nostres jugadors i comunitat, hem estat treballant per a incorporar noves llengües i millorar l’experiència de Those who Came.
Estem contents d’anunciar la incorporació de dues noves llengües al videojoc, que ja estan completament disponibles per a jugar!

Noves llengües:

CAT- Català
[/b]
Dirigeix-te al nostre espai a Steam o a la nostra web per gaudir de Those who Came si encara no ho has fet i jugar amb els teus amics!

Uneix-te a la nostra comunitat a Discord on pots també compartir les teves impressions en Castellà o Català.
Actualment tenim un sorteig en les nostres xarxes socials fins a final de mes.
Gaudeix de Those who Came en les noves llengües!

notes.title: New languages added
notes.content:
[h1]We are happy to announce the addition of two new languages. As always they will be immediately available for use through settings in the game. 
[/h1]

A  Little over a month ago, we launched the demo of our first game, a non-combat RPG multiplayer and we transitioned a few weeks ago into the early access stage. As part of our roadmap and suggestions received from you guys, our cherished players and community, we have been hard at work to add new languages to enhance the overall experience of the game. 
We are happy to announce the addition of two new languages. As always they will be immediately available for use through settings in the game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111472/95045b489ea9673792581e7298e24ae80116e538.png[/img]

New languages 
ESP - Spanish 
CTN - Catalan 

This brings our languages supported to 3. Head over to our steam store/website to enjoy the game if you haven't and play with your friends. 

We currently have an exciting giveaway on our social media until the end of the month. 
Enjoy the new languages!
